step1.title: Welcome to the Skies!
step1.lead: As a Cloud Harvester, you command a floating platform above the cloud harbor.
step1.text: The atmosphere is divided into three distinct altitude strata:
step1.zoneHigh: ❄️ High Zone (Frost Crystals): Thin clouds, pure ice, highest base value (25 CR).
step1.zoneMid: 💧 Mid Zone (Skywater): Balanced moisture, stable extractable volume (10 CR).
step1.zoneLow: ⚡ Low Zone (Storm Charge): Dense storm clouds, high volatility (18 CR).

step2.title: Steering Probe & Drill Head
step2.lead: Guide the probe head by clicking or touching directly.
step2.text: Click below the platform and drag downwards into the cloud banks. The probe automatically carves a clear borehole channel through which you can glide freely later.
step2.instruction1: Click below the platform and drag the pointer downwards.
step2.instruction2: The probe carves a permanent borehole channel.
step2.instruction3: Inside carved channels, the probe glides at full 380 px/s!
step2.tip: 💡 The braided suspension cable reacts with realistic catenary sag and turbulence.

step3.title: Matching Drill Heads
step3.lead: Always align your drill head with the current altitude zone!
step3.text: Quick-switch heads via keys [Q], [W], [E] or using the bottom dock:
step3.headIce: ❄️ Ice Drill [Key Q]: Slices effortlessly through frozen high strata.
step3.headFog: 💧 Fog Scoop [Key W]: Draws in moist mid-stratum vapor droplets.
step3.headCharge: ⚡ Charge Needle [Key E]: Channels and grounds deep storm static.
step3.warning: ⚠️ Warning: Equipping the wrong head incurs a 50% speed penalty and heavy drag resistance!

step4.title: Harvesting Condensate Pockets
step4.lead: Locate and dock onto glowing condensate reservoirs.
step4.text: Guide the probe tip into a glowing pocket. It locks into center with an elastic latch. Crystalline droplets travel up the cable into your harvester tank.
step4.tip: 💡 Tank full? Connect logistics pipes or sell at the Harbor Market to bank Credits (CR).

step5.title: Wind Sensor Sonar Scan
step5.lead: Use the sonar when valuable pockets are shrouded in dense haze.
step5.text: Select tool slot 1 [Key 1] for the Wind Sensor. Click anywhere in the cloud layers to emit an acoustic sonar wave. The hot/cold telemetry leads the way:
step5.signalHot: 🔥 HOT: Pocket directly in harvesting range!
step5.signalWarmer: ⚡ WARMER: Strong condensate signal detected nearby.
step5.signalColder: ❄️ COLD: Weak echo, scan another altitude layer.

step6.title: Cloud Drift & Sky-Council
step6.lead: The sky is never static – it sways on a 4-week pendulum cycle!
step6.text: Cloud bands drift smoothly east and west, returning to their origin every 4 weeks. Click [🔨 AUCTION] in the header to bid against AI rivals for prime bands and earn Sky-Council shares!
step6.auctionText: Click [🔨 AUCTION] in the header anytime to place bids on 6 procedural cloud bands. AI rivals bid against you with distinct personalities!
step6.tip: 🌟 Rule the cloud seas and build your harvesting syndicate. Good luck, Harvester!
